memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; works full-time as a software engineer; no difficulty climbing stairs or walking.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal); no cognitive concerns.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (below 12‑second threshold), fall risk not raised.
medicines: 4 regular (levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, tiotropium inhaler OD); not polypharmacy.
mood: Reports occasional work‑related stress but denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Meera Shah (mother).
goals: "My goal is to stay active and manage my symptoms so I can continue working."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
levothyroxine 50 mcg oral daily
mebeverine 135 mg oral twice daily
ispaghula husk 5 g oral daily
salbutamol inhaler 2 puffs as needed for wheeze
tiotropium inhaler 1 inhalation oral daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 4.2 mIU/L (ref 0.4‑4.0) – slightly high
Free T4 11.2 pmol/L (ref 9.0‑19.0) – normal

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 14.8 g/L, WBC 6.2×10⁹/L, Plt 210×10⁹/L – all normal
Stool routine: ova/cysts negative, no occult blood
tTG‑IgA: <2 U/mL (ref <7) – negative, makes coeliac unlikely

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Spirometry: FEV1 2.6 L (78% predicted), FVC 3.2 L, FEV1/FVC 81% (above 0.70) – mild obstructive pattern, consistent with COPD.
No significant bronchodilator response.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Been having more bloating and occasional loose stools after meals; also noticing mild shortness of breath on climbing two flights of stairs. Want to check if my IBS meds need adjusting.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still independent; reports mild increase in dyspnoea on exertion, but ADL unchanged.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (annual screen) – unchanged.
falls: No falls; gait slightly slower; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (<12) – fall risk not raised.
medicines: 5 regular (levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, tiotropium inhaler OD, salbutamol inhaler SOS counted as regular? Actually SOS not regular; we have 4 regular. Let's adjust: we will add budesonide-formoterol later. For now 4 regular.
But we need to show polypharmacy if >=5. We'll keep 4.
mood: Notes occasional anxiety about breathing.
carers: Meera Shah (mother).
goals: "I want to keep working without feeling breathless."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
levothyroxine 75 mcg oral daily
mebeverine 135 mg oral twice daily
ispaghula husk 5 g oral daily
salbutamol inhaler 2 puffs as needed
tiotropium inhaler 1 inhalation oral daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 2.8 mIU/L (ref 0.4‑4.0) – within target after dose increase
Free T4 12.5 pmol/L (ref 9.0‑19.0) – normal

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked with Dr Nandini Kulkarni for 2025-09-15 at 10:30 am. Patient confirmed via clinic app.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports good energy levels; able to walk 30 min without dyspnoea.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 – stable.
falls: No falls; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (levothyroxine 75 mcg OD, mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, tiotropium inhaler OD, budesonide-formoterol inhaler BD started); now polypharmacy (≥5) – request review against Beers criteria.
mood: Denies depression; mild work stress.
carers: Meera Shah (mother).
goals: "I aim to maintain my current activity level and avoid any exacerbations."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler two puffs twice daily
levothyroxine 75 mcg oral daily
mebeverine 135 mg oral twice daily
ispaghula husk 5 g oral daily
salbutamol inhaler 2 puffs as needed
tiotropium inhaler 1 inhalation oral daily

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Chest X‑ray: lungs clear, no infiltrate or effusion. Cardiac silhouette within normal limits. No signs of hyperinflation beyond expected COPD changes.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Dr S. Rao, Pulmonology, Vikram Hospital, for optimisation of COPD management and assessment of inhaler technique. Include recent spirometry and chest X‑ray reports.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pulmonology review: patient demonstrates good inhaler technique; FEV1 unchanged; recommend continuing current regimen and annual flu vaccine. No further changes needed.
